description: This file defines an OpikLogger class for logging events to an Opik Server, including both synchronous and asynchronous methods. It manages HTTP clients, builds payloads, and handles external dependencies for logging and API interaction, indicating it is a core component for logging within a Python-based project.

classes.name: OpikLogger
classes.description: A logger class for sending LLM event data to an Opik server, supporting both synchronous and asynchronous operations, with internal management of HTTP clients, payload creation, and interaction with an external Opik client if available.
